title.narrative: Network of women entrepreneurs - alumni of the Women Entrepreneurs' Development Programme created

description.narrative: The Women Entrepreneurs’ Development Program was created in 2022 in partnership with one of the largest commercial banks in Georgia - the Bank of Georgia. It aims to serve small and medium entrepreneurs from rural areas of Georgia, including those who need basic skills to be able to apply to larger grants programmes, as well as those who already have basic skills and need further support with different components of business development. The program is built on four pillars: education, support, experience, and cooperation. The Women Entrepreneurs' Programme will create game-changing opportunities for over 200 women-led start-ups and growing companies across the country.

title.narrative: Number of new initiatives conducted in support to the implementation of the care economy and active labor market policies for advancing social and economic rights of the most vulnerable

description.narrative: UNJP4GE’s activities will enhance policy interventions to respond to the internationally recognized care economy framework. Namely, to recognize, reduce and redistribute unpaid care work; invest in quality care services, care policies and care-relevant infrastructure; encourage the promotion of active labor market policies that support the attachment, reintegration and progress of unpaid caretakers into the labor force; promote family-friendly working arrangements, including through cooperation with the state and private sectors; regulate and implement decent terms and conditions of employment for care workers; Promote social dialogue and strengthen the right to collective bargaining in care sectors; support the building of alliances between trade unions representing care workers and civil society organizations.
